results.title: PI Behavioral Assessment Questions and Answers [2026]
results.content: * **The PI Behavioral Assessment** - a personality test. 2. PI Behavioral Assessment Practice Test Questions. The Predictive Index Behavioral Assessment [Also known as the PI Personality Index test] is a personality test where you select adjectives from two lists of **86 adjectives**. Each of the 86 adjectives in the Predictive Index test relates to one of **four key factors**. ## PI Behavioral Assessment Practice Test Questions. Our complete PrepPack offers all 86 adjectives divided by PI Behavioral factors, custom practice tests, and strategies to help you succeed. In addition, most positions require demonstrating more than one factor when answering the Predictive Index Behavioral Assessment, with varying importance levels for each factor. To show more and less dominant factors in your personality, you need to **choose several adjectives according to their level of importance for your position.**. * Guidance and PI behavioural assessment practice tests for correctly classifying adjectives into each of the 4 assessed personality factors.
